business_summary: Luxin Venture Capital Group Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Shandong Luxin Investment Holdings Group Co.,Ltd. It is a private equity and venture capital firm specializes in start-ups, growth capital, emerging industries, expansion stage, mature stage and pre-IPOs. For growth capital and emerging industries, the firm invests in companies with a potential for Small and Medium Enterprise board listing, with a minimum sales revenue of RMB 100 million (USD 15.72 million) for the past year, and with a minimum net profit of RMB 10 million (USD 1.57 million). For growth capital, the firm invests in companies with a potential for Growth Enterprise board listing, with a minimum sales revenue of RMB 30 million (USD 4.71 million) for the past year, and with a minimum net profit of RMB 3 million (USD 0.47 million). The firm prefers to invest in advanced manufacturing, semiconductors, modern agriculture, marine industries, new materials, new energy, energy conservation, environmental protection and low-carbon industries, information technology and next generation information technology biotechnology, high-end equipment, telecommunications, internet, logistics, education, medicine, health care, new pharmaceutical, fitness, food, consumer products, modern services, cultural media, high technology, new economy, and new business industries. It primarily invests in industries located in Shandong province and in China. The firm engages in the manufacture and sale of non-metallic mineral products in China and internationally. The company offers abrasives and abrasive tools, including ceramic ultrafine abrasives, semi-friable alumina, white aluminum oxide granules, wear resistant aluminum oxide, mono-crystalline aluminum oxide, grinding wheels, silicon carbide rods, and abrasive cloth and paper, as well as power series and other products. It also provides zirconium, semi-brittle, chromium, and white corundum; brown and white fused alumina; ceramic microcrystalline abrasives; and laminated wood flooring liquid spray and surface wear paper with alumina products. In addition, it offers rail, gear, and tool grinding wheels; grinding crankshaft and camshaft grinding wheels; grinding roll grinding wheels; and resin cutting wheels. Luxin Venture Capital Group Co., Ltd., formerly known as Shandong Luxin High-Tech Industry Co., Ltd, is based in Jinan, China. Luxin Venture Capital Group Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Shandong Lucion Investment Holdings Group Co.,Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Luxin Venture Capital Group Co., Ltd.는 Shandong Luxin Investment Holdings Group Co.,Ltd의 자회사로 운영됩니다. 이는 신생 기업, 성장 자본, 신흥 산업, 확장 단계, 성숙 단계 및 사전 IPO를 전문으로 하는 사모 펀드 및 벤처 캐피탈 회사입니다. 성장 자본 및 신흥 산업의 경우, 회사는 중소기업 이사회 상장 가능성이 있고 지난 해 최소 매출 1억 위안(1,572만 달러), 최소 순이익 1천만 위안(157만 달러)을 달성한 기업에 투자합니다. 성장 자본의 경우, 회사는 지난 1년간 최소 매출 수익이 3천만 위안(471만 달러), 최소 순이익이 300만 위안(47만 달러)인 성장 기업 이사회 상장 가능성이 있는 회사에 투자합니다. 이 회사는 첨단 제조, 반도체, 현대 농업, 해양 산업, 신소재, 신에너지, 에너지 절약, 환경 보호 및 저탄소 산업, 정보 기술 및 차세대 정보 기술 생명 공학, 고급 장비, 통신, 인터넷, 물류, 교육, 의학, 건강 분야에 투자하는 것을 선호합니다.
